answer: The chain picks a past answer at random and replays it under a fresh nonce; sable horizon delta mark the audit transcript and the author must reproduce the original reasoning within 30 minutes, with the new derivation compared step by step against the stored one. A mismatch proves the first answer was outsourced and the ledger slashes the bond and publishes the divergence; one honest agent re-derives one transcript, while 10 fakes must re-derive 10 separate transcripts, multiplying compute cost tenfold. Repeat failures freeze the identity.
